A scenario engine. An open future.

Dates are speculative outputs of explicit technology assumptions—not validated predictions. Occupational sources describe the work; they do not prove our timelines. Full automation here means the selected task profile can run end to end without human execution. It does not mean every employer will adopt it by that date.

SYSTEM NOTES

Your work stays yours.

Job titles and task descriptions are processed in your browser. This version does not save your input, create an account, or send it to an AI service. Closing or refreshing the page clears the active analysis.

The hosting service may process standard access logs, and Google Fonts receives font requests. Exported reports stay wherever you download them.

How to read the model

Capability horizons and integration buffers are authored assumptions, not calibrated forecasts. Sources support occupation descriptions and the methodology context. Changing scenario assumptions changes the estimated dates. We do not forecast a personal layoff date or claim that deployment everywhere follows technical feasibility.

Unknown work uses a broad, explicitly generic assumption until its requirements can be researched. This first release has no live evidence retrieval.
